GALE SENTINEL · 2027 ROADMAP · CONFIDENTIAL

Distribution: P. Gale (CEO) · Product Committee · C. Arden (Halloway Meridian Capital, shareholder)

Slide 4 · NIGHTWATCH

Low-light facial recognition (0.1 lux). Target accuracy: 94%. Integration with the 412,000 doorbells installed across the Seattle metro area. Launch: Q2 2027.

Slide 7 · ANOMALY

Automatic detection of “inconsistent thermal signatures”: individuals captured on video whose body temperature is abnormally low or fails to register. Use case: “detection of intruders wearing thermal clothing.” Internal model label: COLD_SUBJECT.

Slide 9 · PARTNERSHIPS

Data-access pilot for security partners.

  • Seattle Police Department (in negotiation)
  • Port of Seattle (signed)
  • Northline Cyber Advisory (pilot active since 09/2026, full access to ANOMALY)
“We see what the city doesn't.”

Format: leaked presentation (three printed slides). When: @UUID[JournalEntry.5hwXPdn0tUJ3NaKZ.JournalEntryPage.wIpc0OR2nQf7WDFO]{A1-E05 · The City's Eyes} (Ezra finds it on a poorly secured test server) or @UUID[JournalEntry.C7cxKf7kcAELzuJ1.JournalEntryPage.EjJ0vfVBCjTTb0QV]{A3-E02 · The Data Center}.

Foreshadows: the technological threat to the entire Camarilla. The Northline pilot means Halloway's tool is already in the hunters' hands.

Truth: it's real. Preston Gale is selling technology to Northline without knowing what Northline is. Halloway knows, and considers it an acceptable risk. Celeste Arden (@UUID[JournalEntry.zQMt8VMfKPoL6INq]{Celeste Arden}) is on the distribution list because her shell company is the majority shareholder.
